_meta.description: Source of truth for SodClaw's own improvement list. The dashboard reads this; ROADMAP.md is the narrative companion. Mirrors the portfolio.json + registry.md pattern.

scoring.value: 1-5 — how much shipping this moves Meatbag Labs work forward (NOT how clever it is)
scoring.complexity: 1-5 — engineering effort to build it (1 = an hour, 5 = a week)
scoring.ratio: value / complexity — sort by this to find the sweet-spot wins

_meta.rule: Items move down the stack only when started, never when 'considered.' New requests land in queued first.

items.title: Portfolio sweep — loop edition (verifier + budget guard + in-app gate)
items.summary: Turn the weekly sweep from a cron job into a trustable loop: a Haiku verifier grades the report against the real diff, a budget guard tiers models under a per-run cap, and held state-changes (shelves, re-scores, onboards) wait for in-app approval in the Claude sweep thread (NOT Slack). Lowest-blast-radius place to prove maker-checker before templating onto content agents. Spec: workflows/portfolio_sweep_loop.md. BUILT 2026-06-29: skills/sweep-verifier, skills/sweep-gate, skills/sweep-budget — all three wired into portfolio-sweep/SKILL.md and unit-tested. Remaining: first live full-portfolio Friday run to prove end-to-end.

items.title: Gated self-improvement (outcome logs → proposed edits → in-app gate)
items.summary: Agents read their own outcome logs, propose ONE evidence-backed edit to their prompt/skill/rubric, Kevin ratifies through the existing gate before it takes effect. Agents propose, never self-apply. Substrate (per-agent outcome log) is the real first build and rides on the sweep loop's ratify/reject signal. Prove on the sweep, aim at the content agents. Depends on portfolio_sweep_loop. Strategy: workflows/self_improvement_strategy.md.

items.title: Idea Board on the dashboard
items.summary: Holding pen for new project ideas, scored on value/feasibility/desire/learning. Slows the rate at which new projects begin.

items.title: Surface SodClaw's roadmap on the dashboard
items.summary: This panel. Mirror of sodclaw_roadmap.json, value × complexity scored, traps listed separately.

items.title: External-signal ingestion — fantasy football only
items.summary: Weekly Haiku subagent scans 3–5 specific sources, drops the top 1–3 finds into the Idea Board tagged source:external. One domain. Five sources. One digest/week. Kevin ratifies.

items.title: GitHub deep-link buttons on project cards
items.summary: 'Work on this' opens the project's repo or PR queue in the browser instead of just sending a prompt. Falls back to sendPrompt if no remote on file.

items.title: Event-triggered routines (file-change → action)
items.summary: Routines fire on git commits or file changes instead of cron. e.g., train_lore commits → auto-draft a @sodtoshi promo. Useful once enough routines exist to chain.

items.title: Self-reviewing blog drafts
items.summary: Posts pass through a critique subagent before Kevin sees them. Only useful once content cadence is steady — today the bottleneck is writing, not reviewing.

items.title: Lighter subagent architectures
items.summary: More patterns for Haiku-tier delegation. portfolio-sweep and asset-audit already use it; let practice teach what's worth generalizing.

items.title: Cross-project idea synthesis
items.summary: Subagent notices when two projects share a theme and proposes a connection. Needs a real corpus of ideas before it has anything to chew on.

traps.title: Generic agentic framework
traps.why: Day-job energy, not Meatbag Labs energy. Channel curiosity into one specific routine, not platform.

traps.title: 'Ideas from every space I'm involved with'
traps.why: Cross-domain crawlers eat unbounded time and produce diluted signal. The 30-day ingestion item is narrow on purpose.

traps.title: Full web-interaction automation
traps.why: Multi-day engineering for ergonomic gain that deep links give you cheaply.

traps.title: SodClaw becoming the work
traps.why: The orchestrator is a tool. Tools earn their keep by getting out of the way. New SodClaw capability must point at portfolio shipment, not at SodClaw itself.
